title: Acts of Union (1800)
key_facts: Pair of acts passed by the Parliament of Great Britain and the Parliament of Ireland
United the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of Ireland into the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland (1801)
Abolished the Irish Parliament and integrated representation at Westminster
causes: Security and governance concerns following the 1798 Irish Rebellion
Desire for closer political and economic integration
Continuation of state formation begun by the 1707 Union
outcome: Creation of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland (1801)

figures.name: Robert Stewart, Viscount Castlereagh
figures.role: Irish chief secretary managing the union

impacts: Consolidated the British state for 19th‑century governance and war
Set the stage for later reforms and eventual partition/home rule debates
